messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered (pager#421) — genqueue error rate >3% in eu-west-1 for 5m, escalation to on-call.
sofia: Taking this — joining bridge now. 🧑‍💻
ops_ellen: On bridge. Quick triage: are we seeing model-side errors, infra OOM, or external dependencies?
sofia: Initial glance: kv_cache miss spike correlated with redis timeouts from redis-eu-3. Stack traces show `redis.timeout` and client retries. No obvious OOMs on GPUs.
ben: If redis is flapping we should prepare a brief status note for customers. Draft below — keep short.
ben: ```Initial update (investigating)
- Impact: Elevated 5xx errors for text-generation and embeddings in eu-west-1 (~3–6% of requests).
- Customer impact: Intermittent 5xx responses; some streaming responses truncated/terminated early.
- Mitigation in progress: routing fallback to eu-central enabled, autoscale applied to genqueue, investigating backend datastore reliability.
- Next update: in ~30 minutes or when new info available.
```
sam: Routing fallback was enabled ~2m ago — metrics show error rate trending down to ~2.6% but still noisy.
liaison-ryan: Can someone confirm which tenants are actively hitting eu-west? Any dedicated customers on that pool who need immediate DMs?
sofia: Quick query results: top noisy tenant_ids: t_42 (enterprise), t_88 (high-vol), plus several small tenants. I'll DM CS with the list and suggested copy. cc @liaison-ryan
laura-legal: Wording looks fine, small edit: avoid the term 'requests failing' — use 'requests returning 5xx' to be precise. Also don't promise ETA > SLA unless confirmed.
ben: Updating draft with Laura's edit and adding workaround suggestion.
ben: ```Updated initial update (for publish)
- Impact: Requests returning 5xx for text-generation and embeddings in eu-west-1 (~3–6% of requests).
- Customer impact: Intermittent 5xx responses and occasional truncated streaming output.
- Mitigation: We enabled routing fallback to eu-central and applied autoscale to genqueue. Customers can set the `prefer_region: eu-central` header as a temporary workaround.
- Next update: in ~30 minutes.
```
statuspage-bot: Draft posted to statuspage staging for review — https://staging-status.redwood.ai/incidents/sp-draft-9876
ops_ellen: Ops ✅. Suggest adding the exact time we enabled fallback and a note that we will post a resolved update after error rate is <0.5% for 10 minutes.
sofia: Adding that now. Also performed `systemctl restart redis` on redis-eu-3 at 17:05 UTC — observed immediate drop in timeout errors on that host.
ben: Finalizing and publishing initial update now. :thumbsup:
statuspage-bot: Initial status update published (sp-9876) — https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/sp-9876
liaison-ryan: I'll send targeted customer DMs to t_42 and t_88 with the publish link and workaround steps.
sofia: Monitoring metrics on bridge. Will escalate if error rate rises above 1.5% again.
sam: Error rate now 0.4% and trending stable after failover and restart. Suggest we wait 10m for sustained recovery before marking resolved.
statuspage-bot: Status page update posted: "Mitigation in progress — monitoring" (17:18 UTC).
sofia: Observed sustained <0.5% for 12 minutes. Marking incident resolved in status page and creating postmortem ticket.
statuspage-bot: Status page update published: Incident resolved (sp-9876). Postmortem ticket created: PMT-224.
ben: Good work team — please add short action items to the PM: (1) fix redis failover script, (2) add failover smoke test, (3) improve tenant routing visibility.
sofia: Adding action items to PMT-224. Will assign owners and ETA.
laura-legal: If any customers ask, use the published status link and avoid speculative root cause language until PM is complete.
sofia: Noted. Closing loop here. Thanks all.
